scope: Fix updates and copy and paste.

topics.title: Fixes for this test build
details: This build fixes updates and copy and paste.
You can still browse files and read them in the app.

topics.title: Install an update
details: The app now stops its browser helper before Setup starts. This lets Setup change files that were in use.
Your Chrome or Edge browser stays open. Helpers from other app folders are left alone.

topics.title: Copy and paste text
details: If Windows cannot open the clipboard, the app keeps a copy of your text. You can still paste that text in the app.
